description: An IMMUTABLE, content-addressed snapshot of one CRM Workflow's graph, keyed by definition_hash. A running Run binds to a version, never to the mutable Workflow — so editing a Workflow can never re-route, duplicate or orphan a Run already executing it. Minted by workflow_engine.versions on save; runtime data, never seeded.

fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: Links the frozen definition to its workflow. Reporting only - the interpreter reads the payload, never this.

fields.label: Version No
fields.description: 1, 2, 3 ... per workflow, to order its versions. For humans; identity is the content hash.

fields.label: Is Current
fields.description: Marks the version a new Instance binds to. Exactly one per workflow; reverting a Definition re-flags that version rather than minting a duplicate.

fields.label: Definition Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the canonical payload; an unchanged save reuses the matching version instead of minting a duplicate. Unique per workflow.

fields.label: Definition (JSON)
fields.description: Stores the immutable, canonical graph an Instance executes; a running Instance reads this, never the editable Definition.

name: CRM Workflow Version
